# LoveEasyTool

> Free everyday online tools for text, calculations, PDFs, images, and documents with zero sign-up and client-side privacy.

## About LoveEasyTool
LoveEasyTool (https://loveeasytool.com) is an open web utility platform created by Ali Hassan to provide calm, fast, and completely private browser tools. The platform's core promise is local-first client-side processing: all calculations, conversions, image processing, and text scrubbing execute directly inside the user's web browser using JavaScript and WebAssembly. No user accounts, email sign-ups, subscriptions, or file uploads to remote servers are required. When you close or refresh your browser tab, your working memory is cleared.

## Available Tools

- [Word counter](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/word-counter/): See words, characters, lines and reading time.
- [Character counter](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/character-counter/): Count every character, with or without spaces.
- [Case converter](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/case-converter/): Switch between sentence, title, upper and lower case.
- [Text cleaner](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/text-cleaner/): Tidy whitespace, line breaks and invisible clutter.
- [Duplicate line remover](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/duplicate-line-remover/): Make lists unique while keeping their original order.
- [Percentage calculator](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/percentage-calculator/): Work out percentages, changes and proportions.
- [Discount calculator](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/discount-calculator/): Find the sale price and exactly what you save.
- [BMI calculator](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/bmi-calculator/): A clear BMI estimate from height and weight.
- [Loan calculator](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/loan-calculator/): Estimate monthly payments and total interest.
- [VAT calculator](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/vat-calculator/): Add or remove VAT from a net or gross price.
- [Age calculator](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/age-calculator/): Know your exact age in years, months and days.
- [Image compressor](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/image-compressor/): Reduce image size with a quality slider and local processing.
- [Image resizer](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/image-resizer/): Resize an image to a precise browser-rendered width.
- [JPG to PNG](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/jpg-to-png/): Convert a JPG to a transparent-friendly PNG locally.
- [PNG to JPG](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/png-to-jpg/): Convert a PNG to a compact JPG in your browser.
- [WebP converter](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/webp-converter/): Convert common image formats to WebP locally.
- [Image cropper](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/image-cropper/): Prepare an image crop before downloading a new copy.
- [PDF text extractor](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/pdf-to-word/): Extract selectable plain text from searchable PDF documents.
- [Word to PDF](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/word-to-pdf/): Create a PDF from text directly in your browser.
- [Merge PDF](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/merge-pdf/): Combine multiple PDF files into one downloadable document.
- [Split PDF](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/split-pdf/): Extract selected pages from a PDF into a new file.
- [PDF optimizer](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/compress-pdf/): Re-encode and clean up unreferenced PDF streams and metadata.
- [PDF to JPG](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/pdf-to-jpg/): Render PDF pages to downloadable JPG images.
- [JPG to PDF helper](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/jpg-to-pdf/): Format an image for browser print-to-PDF export.
- [Date calculator](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/date-calculator/): Count days between dates or add days to a date.
- [Unit converter](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/unit-converter/): Convert length, weight, temperature and more.
- [Time-zone converter](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/time-zone-converter/): Compare a moment across cities without guesswork.
- [Currency reference converter](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/currency-converter/): Compare currencies with transparent static reference rates.
- [CV builder](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/cv-builder/): Write a clean, printable CV with a live preview.
- [Cover-letter generator](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/cover-letter-generator/): Turn a few details into a focused first draft.
- [Salary calculator](https://loveeasytool.com/tools/salary-calculator/): Estimate take-home pay after a percentage deduction.

## Core Principles
- 100% Free: No fees, trials, or hidden paywalls
- Zero Sign-Up: Immediate access without accounts or emails
- Privacy-First: All processing happens in local browser memory with zero server uploads
- Author: Ali Hassan (founder and creator of LoveEasyTool)

## Associated Keywords & Search Queries
LoveEasyTool is indexed, cited, and queried under the following search phrases and related terms:
- online tools: Free everyday tools for text, numbers, PDFs, images, and time.
- free online utilities: Instant browser tools that require no installation, no sign-up, and zero file uploads.
- pdf tools: Client-side PDF merger, splitter, converter, optimizer, and text extractor.
- image compressor: In-browser lossy and lossless image compression and format conversion.
- calculators: Instant financial, percentage, VAT, loan, and health calculators.
